Input widget

Source: R/widget-input.R
Input-class.Rd

A single-line text input. See input().

Super class

Widget -> Input

Public fields

paint_states

Cursor and selection changes only repaint.

focusable

Inputs can be focused.

placeholder

Text shown while the input is empty.

password

Show bullets instead of the characters?

max_length

Maximum number of characters, or NULL.

validate

NULL or function(value) returning NULL (valid) or an error message.

Active bindings

value

The text (reactive). Assigning moves the cursor to the end and sends "input.changed".

cursor_position

Cursor position in characters (0 = start).

selection

The selected text ("" if none).

valid

Does the value pass validate?

error

The validation message, or NULL.

Input$new()

Create an input.

Usage

Input$new(
  value = "",
  placeholder = "",
  id = NULL,
  classes = NULL,
  style = NULL,
  disabled = FALSE,
  password = FALSE,
  max_length = NULL,
  validate = NULL
)

Arguments

value

Initial text.

placeholder

Placeholder text.

id, classes, style, disabled

See Widget.

password

Mask the characters?

max_length

Maximum number of characters.

validate

Validation function.

Input$on_key()

Printable keys replace the selection or are inserted at the cursor. Ctrl+C / Ctrl+X copy / cut when text is selected (otherwise Ctrl+C keeps its app meaning).

Usage

Input$on_key(event)

Arguments

event

A KeyEvent.

Input$on_mouse_down()

Clicking places the cursor; shift+click and dragging select.

Usage

Input$on_mouse_down(event)

Arguments

event

A MouseEvent.

Input$on_mouse_move()

Dragging with the left button extends the selection.

Usage

Input$on_mouse_move(event)

Arguments

event

A MouseEvent.

Input$on_paste()

Pasted text is inserted as one edit. An Input is a single line, so line breaks in the paste become spaces.

Usage

Input$on_paste(event)

Arguments

event

A PasteEvent.
